title: Longworth is awfully sick, he said, after what you wrote about that old hake Gregory
html_source:
On March 26, 1903, Joyce’s review of Lady Augusta Gregory’s work “Poets and Dreamers – Studies and Translations from the Irish” was published in the Daily Express. He panned the book.

Longworth was the editor of the Daily Express.

https://jamesjoyce.ie/day-26-march/
